label: PFC200 G2 controller, 2 x Ethernet
description: WAGO PFC200 2nd-generation PLC/edge controller with 2 x ETHERNET RJ45 ports at 10/100 Mbit/s (internal switch, daisy-chain capable) plus one RS-232/RS-485 interface. Runs Linux with a web-based management UI, SSH and Modbus TCP, EtherNet/IP, BACnet/IP and OPC UA.
